steps.instruction: Read the request, producer receipts and predecessor evidence. Freeze one source head, exact changed-file boundary, declared gates, effective coverage configurations, lint scope and owner-approved debt. Reject mixed or stale predecessor heads.

calls.purpose: Read exact producer, gate and debt evidence.
Verify frozen head and changed paths without mutation.

produces: One frozen delivery and gate plan.

steps.instruction: Run every required declared gate once at the frozen head, including the configured frontend presentation sweep when applicable. Preserve command, configuration, exit status, output and measured coverage. Do not repair source or replace a red result with prose.

calls.purpose: Run the exact declared gate commands.

steps.instruction: Evaluate the gate record against strongest coverage thresholds, declared lint scope, valid debt and unchanged predecessor scorecards. Produce concrete defects and rerun only a gate whose underlying defect has been repaired outside this operator.

calls.purpose: Persist the exact verdict and debt treatment.

produces: Concrete failed-criterion feedback or passing review results.

steps.instruction: Write and validate the response with exact artifact hashes and review results. Keep unavailable gates blocked and red gates visible; only a complete accepted response is done.

calls.purpose: Present the exact gate and verdict table.
